consistency_checks.detail: The arm-specific restrictions IN1, EX1 and EX2 lie inside the Master Protocol limits. IN1 sets a functional score of 38-63 within MP-IN3 (30-70). Each restriction is stated to apply identically to the active and matching-placebo groups in this comparison, as permitted by MP 6.2. They narrow only this concurrent comparison and do not change platform-wide limits, so no Master Protocol amendment under MP 6.4 is implied. consistency_checks.detail: IN1 (functional score 37-63) narrows MP-IN3 (30-70). EX1 adds a hypersensitivity exclusion. EX2 (eGFR below 75) narrows MP-IN4 (at least 60). Each restriction is stated by the sponsor to apply identically to active and matching-placebo participants in this comparison, as permitted by MP-DX-001 6.2. None alters platform-wide limits or the broader shared-control pool. Per MP 6.5, only concurrent controls meeting these comparison criteria contribute to the comparison. Reviewer should confirm that the eGFR restriction is treated as comparison-level narrowing under 6.2 rather than a renal limit change under 6.4.

Sponsor activities are placed at existing shared visits with Master Protocol days and windows unchanged: Week 4 (Day 29 ±3), Week 12 (Day 85 ±5) and Week 24 (Day 169 ±7). No shared visit is moved or added (MP 8.8).

consistency_checks.check: Week 24 predose PK sample versus end of treatment
consistency_checks.detail: The regimen is every 4 weeks for 24 weeks, which implies infusions at Weeks 0-20. MP 8.5 ends assigned treatment at Week 24. The sponsor nevertheless requests a 'predose' PK sample at Week 24, which implies an infusion at Week 24. Clarification is needed on whether a Week 24 infusion occurs. Interim dosing contacts (e.g., Weeks 8, 16, 20) are not specified by the sponsor and have not been added.

EP4 is change from baseline in the DX signal index at Week 12. However, the sponsor specifies a DX signal index blood sample only at Week 12; no baseline (screening or Day 1 predose) sample is specified. No sample has been invented; refer to the sponsor clinical lead.
A 60-minute post-infusion observation is specified only at Week 4. Whether it also applies to the Day 1 infusion or other infusions is not stated. Nothing has been added.

Primary and secondary objectives map directly to the named primary and secondary endpoints. The two exploratory objectives (plasma exposure, DX signal index) are not explicitly linked by the sponsor to the PK and PD endpoints. The links shown (OBJ3-EP3, OBJ4-EP4) are inferred from matching content and require confirmation per MP 7.3.

consistency_checks.check: Primary and safety endpoints aligned with shared endpoint families

No conflicting statements were found between SYN-C18-01, IB-C18-01 and LET-C18-01. The IB states it does not withdraw any regimen. Development history, manufacturing, formulation and correspondence text were treated as background and not converted into appendix content. This draft is a proposal for human clinical review and platform committee approval.

consistency_checks.check: Shared-control population: prior investigational agent requirement
consistency_checks.detail: SYN-C19-01 states 'Participants in both groups must have received an investigational Disease X agent within 30 days before randomization.' This conflicts with MP-EX4 (exclusion of any investigational Disease X agent within 90 days) and is expressly prohibited by MP-DX-001 section 6.3 even when applied to both groups. It has been omitted from the draft inclusion list and requires sponsor clarification and committee review.

IB-C19-01 excludes eGFR below 80 mL/min/1.73 m2 from both groups. This is drafted as a comparison-level restriction under MP sections 6.2 and 9.1 because it applies identically to active and placebo participants and does not change the platform-wide MP-IN4 limit (>= 60). Reviewers should confirm it is not a change to shared renal limits under section 6.4. Per section 6.5, only concurrent controls with eGFR >= 80 and no prior severe hypersensitivity contribute to this comparison, which narrows the usable shared-control pool.
The hypersensitivity exclusion applies to both groups in this comparison and does not alter platform eligibility (MP section 6.2).

Arm-specific activities are placed at existing shared visits with unchanged days and windows: Week 4 Day 29 +/-3, Week 12 Day 85 +/-5, Week 24 Day 169 +/-7 (MP sections 8.3 to 8.5, 8.8). No shared visit is moved and no separate assessment visit is added.

Every-4-week infusions imply dosing contacts between shared visits (e.g., Weeks 8, 16 and 20). Per MP section 8.7 these dosing contacts do not create new shared assessment visits. The sponsor does not specify activities at these contacts; none are drafted.

The sponsor specifies a 60-minute post-infusion observation only at Week 4, although IB-C19-01 reports a transient cytokine signal and infusions occur from Day 1. No observation at Day 1 or other infusions has been added because the sources are silent; flagged for clinical review.
SYN-C19-01 states phase2_3, an accepted platform phase (MP section 1.3).

OBJ1 links to EP1 (baseline to Week 24, consistent with shared efficacy family MP 7.1); OBJ2 links to EP2 (first dose through Day 197, consistent with MP 7.2). No PK/PD endpoints defined by sponsor; none created.

ARM-20 narrows its concurrent comparison (functional score 35-60 vs platform 30-70; eGFR >=65 vs platform >=60; added hypersensitivity exclusion).
